scope: Complete monitor/precision/player-proximity helpers and selected driving cadence consumers

findings.evidence: Monitor samples 0.1s uiSleep wake lateness over2s windows, diag_fps/fpsMin, active scheduled scripts and cumulative vehicle/ray/time deltas. Eight-field stats include elapsed pass milliseconds but renderer does not display its _Ms argument.
findings.disposition: Wake lateness is responsiveness evidence, not frame-time overhead attribution. FPS/min, ray rate and script count cannot certify median/p95 budget. Do not adopt source comments about scheduler budget as verified engine facts.

findings.evidence: Permanent monitor loop uiSleeps1s while unused. Interface clients publish global wanted timestamp when enabled; multiplayer server broadcasts stats while wanted is younger than10s. HC work is not separately requested/reported by this monitor path.
findings.disposition: Retain demand-driven measurement intent; use explicit per-owner evidence, bounded logging and collection lifetime. The claim costs nothing when unused is not literal: dormant loop and driving counters remain. Public diagnostic timestamps are not authority for AI movement.

findings.evidence: Per-vehicle result cached5s. Explicit vehicle precision overrides automatic distance mode. Automatic low scans alive allPlayers minus HeadlessClient_F; no player nearby lowers precision, including dedicated operation with no observers.
findings.disposition: Retain amortized configuration/proximity decisions, but no completion credit from reduced work at distance. Validate close and distant active battles equally. Add deliberate invalidation/owner lifecycle if implementing this mechanism; no source cache copied.

findings.evidence: Driving precision uses obstacle factors2.2/1.5/1 and traffic factors2.2/2.2/1. Independent clocks retain preceding observation/cap between due passes.
findings.disposition: Separate expensive observation clocks can help cost, provided maximum observation age, speed/reaction horizon and continuous safety authority are validated. Never release a collision hold merely because a slower scan is not due. No WAIT cadence change made.

findings.evidence: playersNear filters alive non-HC players below10m ATL; optional direction heuristic projects body getDir by range and halves radius if projected look is farther than0.7radius. It performs no line-of-sight or actual camera-view query.
findings.disposition: Not visibility proof: airborne observers, camera/Zeus views, occlusion and body-versus-view direction can disagree. Do not use it to justify hidden teleport/physics recovery. It is distinct from precision distance selection.

findings.evidence: Standalone performance fixture samples diag_deltaTime every frame for60s after20s warmup; validates50 moving server-owned groups, surviving actors, composition and observer continuity. Reporter compares matched clean provenance and median/p95 against5/10percent limits.
findings.disposition: Useful patrol-only paired benchmark. Does not prove combat, CQB, queues, actual HC ownership, multi-owner coordination or client/JIP costs. Whole-addon budget remains unaccepted. Repeated matched runs and diverse workloads remain required.

nextAcceptance: Measure normal and actual-HC workloads separately
Include combat/CQB/convoy stalls and changing ownership, with matching behaviour outcomes
Capture frame-time distributions plus operation latency/scan age so reduced responsiveness cannot masquerade as performance success
Use repeated matched native/WAIT candidates; record hardware/runtime/dependency identities and observer continuity
